Hi Lena / DeepWell team —

Thanks for signing the contract. Quick note from CS/impl to get the initial tenant and API keys provisioned so your engineers can start smoke-testing next week. Please confirm the bullets below and attach the completed tenant sheet (I attached the template):

- Admin contact for initial access (name + email)
- Desired project name(s) for production and staging (we recommend deepwell-prod / deepwell-staging)
- SSO required? If yes, IdP type (Okta/Azure/Google) and SP metadata where applicable
- KMS/HSM key usage for embedding/encryption? (yes/no)
- Preferred window for key seeding (MM/DD, timezone) — we have capacity 05/11 AM PT or 05/12 PM PT

What we'll do after you confirm:
- Create org workspace + projects, seed admin account and one service account
- Seed API keys into a one-time key escrow (we'll share via your SSO or encrypted doc)
- Share role matrix and invite cadence for end-users
- Kickoff 30m technical handoff with infra/eng (calendar link after confirmation)

Attachments: tenant-setup-template.xlsx (please fill the top sheet and return)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Priyom Das

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Lena — looks good. I'll take point on the provisioning steps and document the mutual action plan (MAP). High-level plan below: 

1) Pre-seed (05/10):
   - Finalize SSO metadata and KMS ARN from DeepWell
   - Create org and projects (deepwell-prod / deepwell-staging) in our console

2) Seed & handoff (05/11 09:00 PT):
   - Create service account and seed initial API keys (we'll deliver a single-use secret via your Ops channel)
   - Configure role bindings: Org Admin (Samir), Workspace Admin (Lena), Dev (team role)
   - Validate basic generate/embeddings call (small smoke test)

3) Post-seed (05/12):
   - Share MAP PDF (DW-MAP-v1.pdf) with tasks and owners
   - Schedule follow-up 60m deep-dive for integration questions (optional)

Attachments: DW-MAP-v1.pdf (draft MAP)

Action items for DeepWell: share Okta SAML metadata, provide KMS ARN and confirm the preferred delivery channel for secrets (we support SSO-provisioned keys or encrypted vault delivery).

I'll prepare a short calendar invite for the 05/11 09:00 PT window — can everyone accept?

— Monica
